neighbours.label: the word joining two numbers in a range, size or score, right after the first number ('2:00 PM to 3:00', 'aged 5 to 12', '39 x 30 cm', '12 by 14 feet', '9-to-5', 'won 3 to 1'): a second number comes next; 'to', 'by' and 'x' that do not join two numbers stay quiet
fire: The museum is open from 10 AM to 6 PM on weekdays.
Most adults sleep 7 to 9 hours a night.
The trail climbs from 1,200 to 2,400 metres.
Our team lost the game 2 to 0.
Temperatures will range from 18 to 25 degrees.
quiet: The museum is open to the public on weekdays.
Most adults need to sleep more than they do.
The rug was sent to us by mail.
The trail climbs to the ridge after 1,200 metres.
Our team went to the game by bus.
The shed was built by my father in 2010.
The store opens at 8 on Saturdays.
neighbours.short: 'to' / 'x' / 'by' joining two numbers (a range, size or score)
neighbours.notes: A shared feeder of the predictable-digit units: 6 L35/N1376+ (drop 0.25), 3 L35/N6726- (0.15) and 8 L35/N7741- (0.17). Probes: number-joining 'to' 0.38-0.90, ' x' 0.56, '-to' 0.70, ' by' 0.38; 'to the store', 'to his brother', 'rose by 4 percent' <= 0.01. Its - pole is the citation and date abbreviation before a number (Vol, pp, Nov., Jan.).
